newsitem.title: SPAIN: Slain Spanish politician laid to rest.
newsitem.headline: Slain Spanish politician laid to rest.

text.p: Miguel Angel Blanco, a young politician kidnapped and killed by Basque separatist guerrillas, was laid to rest on Monday in his hometown.

In a solemn ceremony broadcast live on national television, Blanco was entombed in a crypt at Ermua's cemetery. Thousands of mourners, including Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar and Crown Prince Felipe, gathered to pay their last respects.
Crowds, held back by red-jacketed Basque police, chanted "Miguel, Miguel, Miguel" and "Murderers! Murderers!" as his casket was carried through narrow streets on the way to the cemetery.
Blanco's killing has sparked an angry public outcry in Spain against the rebel group ETA, which has waged a violent 29-year struggle for an independent homeland.
Blanco, 29, a low-ranking member of Spain's ruling party, was kidnapped last Thursday by ETA, which threatened to execute him in 48 hours if the government did not meet their demands.

He was found on Saturday dumped on a mountain roadside outside the Basque city of San Sebastian, his hands tied behind his back and two bullets in his brain. He slipped into a coma and died before dawn on Sunday.
